name: Zenna Dale
description: JD had a brief romantic interest in Zenna in April 2016. By 2017 she and Bronwyn were friends — both appeared in the Chitty Chitty Bang Bang cast. That overlap made navigating the Bronwyn situation more layered than it would otherwise have been.
bio: Part of the Moira-era friend group. Was Bronwyn's close friend and JD's primary go-between through Fall 2017. Also the first person who demonstrated genuine feelings toward JD — around age 15. That experience changed his internal operating premise from "no one likes you" to something more open. Their moment ended in April 2016. The go-between role shifted to Katie McGrath beginning January 2018.
